text: Over the past two weeks, I have generally felt interested and engaged in my daily activities.
I have been feeling down, heavy, or persistently sad more often than not recently.
I find it difficult to fall asleep, stay asleep, or I sleep far more than usual.
I often feel restless, on edge, or unable to relax even when there's no clear reason.
My energy levels have felt consistently low, making everyday tasks feel harder than they should.
I have been worrying excessively about multiple things and find it hard to stop.
I have trouble concentrating on tasks, reading, or watching things I normally enjoy.
I have been feeling generally hopeful about the future.
I tend to withdraw from friends and family when I'm going through a tough time.
Overall, I feel emotionally balanced and able to handle what life throws at me.
